parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry `is_test: true` and reside in `Shared/Playlist/Tests/PlaylistTests/PlaylistAPIVersionTests.swift`. The structural similarity (Jaccard 0.78) between `PlaylistAPIVersionTests.returnsV1WhenFeatureFlagIsV1` and `PlaylistAPIVersionTests.invalidFeatureFlagFallsBackToDefault` reflects the natural parallel structure of test methods exercising related but distinct behaviours of the same API-version feature-flag logic. Collapsing them into a generic helper would obscure test intent and couple distinct failure modes. The restraint marker `is_test: true` on every record in the cluster dominates any action signal.
